note: The closed questions a local vision-language model is asked about ONE crop of a plan. One source for the relay (server/vlm-core.mjs), the benchmark (benchmarks/offline-intelligence/local-vlm-bench2.py) and the training set (training/vlm_lora.py): a question the product asks is word for word the question that was measured and trained. Changing a word here is a new measurement.
preamble: This is a crop of an event venue floor plan, drawn from above.

questions.identify: What single object is at the centre of the image? Answer with exactly one word from: {words}.
questions.count: How many tables are in the image? Count only tables, not chairs, sofas or benches. Answer with a number only.
questions.chairs: How many chairs stand around the table in the centre? Answer with a number only.
questions.merged: Do the tables in the centre touch each other to form one long table? Answer yes or no.
questions.serves: Does the {piece} stand directly against the table so people on it sit at that table? Answer yes or no.
